feeds.title: Urakkamaailma Blog
feeds.description: Urakkamaailma publishes renovation and home-related blog posts, articles, and studies. In the blog, we give advice and instructions on everything related to the home; from decorating to renovation. We are a marketplace for contractors and people with various renovation needs such as homeowners and property managers.

feeds.title: Helsinki Design Blog
feeds.description: Take a read on our blog posts that carries a range of Helsinki Design products including design furniture, lamps, home accessories, crockery, textiles, and table decorations. We have specialized in Finnish and Scandinavian design. Our products are high quality, functional, natural, and sustainable.
